title: Logging of Changes to Contract Account
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM

fe)

e«° Example

For automatic payment clearing, you specify that a payment on account is always assigned to the account holder.

Logging of Changes to Contract Account

Use

Changes to fields of the contract account are logged. The changes can be displayed in the dialog maintenance of the contract

account. It also contains information about who created a contract account when, and who made the last change.

Key Features

In the menu, choose the transaction Extras and then choose the desired menu entry in the following table.

Menu Entry

Creation Data

Account Changes

Field Changes

The system displays the following:

Who created a contract account when and last changed it

There is a difference here between general and business-partner-
specific data.

All the changes to an account.

During execution, the system offers a selection list of all fields that
have previously been changed on the account. In addition, the

system displays cross-business-partner and business-partner-
specific details regarding the creation data of the account, and
additional data on business partners.

By selecting individual fields, you can select the change data. After
confirming the entries, a list of all the changes appears, specifying
the person who made them and the date of the change.

Changes to the field on which the cursor is positioned.

After choosing this function, a list with the changes made to this

field appears, specifying the person who made them and the date
of the change.

No change documents are written for process locks. You can display the history for the display locks from the dialog for the locks

Automatic Master Data Transfer

Use

You use this function to transfer the contract account master data from legacy or operational systems.
